data.gender_notes: Aamra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘A-M-R’, meaning ‘to support, help, and sustain’. In Islamic history, Aamra is a name for a noble woman who provides support and care to her loved ones. The name Aamra carries the meaning “Support, help” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aamra usually hope their child will grow to embody support, help and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing support and nurturing in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Aamra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, help.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aamra total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Aamra
in_english.meaning: daughter of a prince or noble, princess, noblewoman
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aamra is derived from the Arabic word Amir, which means commander, leader, ruler, or noble. In Islamic tradition, Aamra is the daughter of an Amir, a noble or a prince. The name Aamra is often used to signify that the child is from a noble or royal lineage, or that she is a noblewoman herself. In some cultures, Aamra is also associated with the Arabic word Amira, which means princess or noblewoman. In Islamic tradition, Aamra is also considered a symbol of honor, dignity, and nobility. It is also associated with the qualities of bravery, leadership, and wisdom.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aamra carries a rich cultural connotation as the epitome of strength, resilience, and compassion. Historically, Aamra is a name for a woman who stands as a pillar of strength for her family, providing emotional, physical, and moral support during challenging times. In many contemporary Muslim communities, Aamra is believed to embody the virtues of patience, self-sacrifice, and kindness, qualities that Muslim women are encouraged to emulate in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Aamra lies in its association with the divine attributes of loving-kindness (Rahman) and generosity (Rahim), as mentioned in the Quran (Ar-Rahman 55:1). By embodying the qualities of Aamra and extending support and care to her loved ones, a woman bearing this name is said to be reflecting the very essence of God's love and compassion. Thus, the name Aamra serves as a reminder of the importance of selflessness and serving others in the pursuit of spiritual growth and fulfillment.
